paragraphs: Harmari sells tools that identify and monitor short term rentals so a municipality can collect lodging tax and enforce local rules. A companion product covers long term rentals through website monitoring, rental identification and a rental registry. Another line addresses municipal business licensing and revenue enhancement.

The tools analyze many classifieds at once, which the company presents as faster and more complete than working through them by hand. The short term rental product works with Taxcrawler to find and watch properties for lodging tax collection, licensing and code compliance. Evidence collection standards call for at least two screenshots. The company states a 95% accuracy guarantee for houses and 75% for condos. There is a tax reporting module with under-reporting detection. A registration portal is customized to local laws. Enforcement outreach runs by phone and direct mail.

Buyers include state and municipal revenue agencies with units that look for taxpayers who are not compliant. The company says Taxcrawler has helped revenue departments find and recoup tax revenue. Condominium and homeowner associations are addressed by a separate short term rental finder. Work outside those products can be taken on as custom data collection or web scraping.
